title: The long watch
lines: dm
Night falls on the Ash Road and the party makes camp in a ruined barn. The roof is half gone, the floor is damp straw, and the wind carries the smell of old smoke.
a
Pip says, "First watch is mine," and climbs into the loft.
b
Sorrel crouches by the fire, feeds it a split plank, and sharpens her knife on a whetstone.
c
Hadrian says, "I am sleeping with my boots on."
dm
The fire pops. From the loft, Pip hears hoofbeats on the road, far off and slow.
a
Pip wakes Sorrel and Hadrian with a soft whistle and whispers, "Someone is coming."
dm
A rider stops outside the barn and does not dismount. The horse blows steam into the cold air. The rider wears a long wet cloak, and the face stays in shadow.
b
Sorrel steps to the door and asks, "What do you want?"
dm
The rider holds out a folded letter and says nothing. The wax on it is black and smells of pine.
c
Hadrian takes the letter and breaks the seal.
dm
The letter holds a single line: the bridge is already burning. The paper is damp and smells of smoke.
a
Pip looks along the road from the loft.
dm
On the horizon an orange glow flickers, and the smell of smoke is stronger now.
